posts.text: 🚨 @ThePeriodDoctor, Dr. Charis Chambers, stopped by to discuss her new book, The Period and Puberty Parenting Revolution. She explains why fathers should be part of the conversation about menstruation and puberty, emphasizing that their support can make a meaningful difference in their daughters' lives. The book offers practical guidance on how dads can show up during this important stage and help their daughters navigate it with confidence. 💜📖 Check out the full conversation on @netflix
